title: China rivalry and selective cooperation
description: Refer to ‘Xi has the measure of Trump’; the trajectory of the US-China relationship has become the defining geopolitical story of 2026. When Trump visited China about a decade ago, he appeared to believe that Beijing could be pressured into making concessions. But now Trump’s approach appears to be more flexible and quite respectful that reflects the reality of China’s increased economic, technological and military strength. Xi, for his part, has approached the relationship with greater confidence. China’s objective is to secure greater recognition of its interests, and to ensure that the US respects what Beijing defines as its core concerns, especially on the Taiwan issue. For Asia, India particularly, the challenge is to recognise that the US-China relationship will continue to combine elements of rivalry and selective cooperation.
